numerical_failure.observed_behavior: UECMResults.resid inherited the parent class residual computation and returned residuals computed against the levels series (model.endog), i.e. endog minus fittedvalues, producing values close to the level values of the series instead of differenced residuals; this makes downstream diagnostics such as Durbin-Watson and Breusch-Godfrey incorrect.
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: UECMResults.resid should compute model._y - fittedvalues, using the differenced series (model._y), which is the actual dependent variable in the UECM equation.
trigger_conditions: Accessing resid on a UECMResults object (UECM model fitted results)
Model dependent variable is the first difference of endog stored in model._y, while the inherited resid uses model.endog
oracle_clues: Issue text describes residuals close to the level values of the series, which is a qualitative clue rather than a concrete expected value
